title: Fix backend admin principal so isCallerAdmin grants access to live admin user

requirements.text: In the backend Motoko actor (backend/main.mo), ensure the stored admin principal is exactly 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae'. The isCallerAdmin function (or equivalent authorization check) must compare caller.toText() against this principal. If the admin principal is held in a stable variable, update its initialization default and provide a migration path in backend/migration.mo so the live canister state is overwritten with this value on the next upgrade without losing other data. The error message 'Keine Berechtigung: Nur Admins können Kollektionen verwalten.' must no longer appear for this principal.

quotes: Keine Berechtigung: Nur Admins können Kollektionen verwalten.

acceptanceCriteria: The admin principal stored in the canister stable state equals 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae' after upgrade.
Calling isCallerAdmin (or the equivalent authorization check) as principal 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae' returns true.
Collection management operations (create, update, delete) succeed without returning the 'Keine Berechtigung' error when called by this principal.
No other existing stable state (collections, NFT items, user profiles, minted tokens) is lost during the upgrade.
migration.mo run function correctly seeds or overwrites the admin principal field during the canister upgrade.

requirements.text: In the frontend hook useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout, ensure the hardcoded fallback admin principal is 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae' and that principal comparisons trim whitespace and normalize to lowercase on both sides. Add or confirm console.log output showing: (1) the current caller's principal text, (2) the hardcoded fallback principal, (3) the result of the backend isCallerAdmin call, so that any remaining mismatch on the live site can be diagnosed immediately.

quotes: Keine Berechtigung: Nur Admins können Kollektionen verwalten.

acceptanceCriteria: The hardcoded fallback string in useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout is exactly 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae'.
Principal comparisons use .trim().toLowerCase() on both the caller principal and the hardcoded value.
Browser console logs print the caller principal, fallback principal, and backend isCallerAdmin result during each admin check.
Admin button and Admin Dashboard are accessible for the principal 'uorkh-nazas-r5n3p-kj44w-gwm4i-liaj3-jqjll-ws44w-7dlve-3mshw-sae' on the live site.

constraints: Do not drop or corrupt any existing stable state (collections, NFT items, user profiles, minted tokens) during the backend upgrade.
Do not edit files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture).
nonGoals: Adding new features beyond fixing admin access.
Changing the authentication mechanism away from Internet Identity.
